payload.rationale: A schedule success rate requires like-for-like repair episodes and actual completion dates, not announcements. The research plan is formalized here after the exploratory inquiry searches; it was not a preregistered empirical cohort.
payload.population: Large outdoor public reflecting-pool coating or sealant failures requiring drainage and rework while existing basin structure remains serviceable.
payload.selection_rule: Include independent episodes with an observed repair decision/start, comparable coating scope, and a verified return to normal operation; require the full 55-day horizon and outcome to be knowable before the cutoff. Exclude routine cleaning, full basin reconstruction, unverified schedules and duplicate reports of one episode.
payload.metric: Share restoring normal filled operation within approximately 55 days of the repair decision.
search_plan: Search Lincoln Reflecting Pool historic repair, drainage and reopening episodes.
Check NPS and Interior primary notices and distinguish scheduled from realized durations.
Reject incomparable scopes and absent outcome ascertainment.
limitations: Convenience searches are not an exhaustive census.
No eligible cohort has yet been established.
